original_test_intent: Verify the complete SMBIOS Type 13 installable-language string set contains exactly the approved BIOS languages in the declared abbreviated or long format, has a consistent count/current-language reference and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 13 records, preserve declared language count, flags, every string index/value and current-language index/value, normalize only under an approved locale policy, compare the set/order and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the installable-language list, identifier format/normalization and reboot plan. BIOS UI translation quality or interactive language selection is optional separate manual scope.
required_inputs: Expected language identifiers and whether order is significant
Expected Type 13 flags specifying identifier format
Rules for case, separators, locale aliases, duplicates and unsupported identifiers
Allowed current language and requirement that it reference an installable entry
Validated parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS collection; do not change BIOS language or firmware.
Capture the entire Type 13 string set; `grep -A1` can retain only the first list line and is not complete evidence.
Interpret language strings according to the Type 13 flag before normalization; do not compare abbreviated and long formats as identical without policy.
Validate declared count and current-language index against the actual string table; do not infer UI translation completeness from metadata.
Stop on malformed indices/list, unsupported identifiers, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Parse all Type 13 language strings with raw count/flags/current index, apply approved normalization and compare set/order and persistence.
Do not change locale, judge visual translation or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve language inventory, identifier-format and normalization/order rules.
Approve reboot/recovery, arrange separate UI translation validation if required and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field label is relevant, but `-A1` truncates a multi-language list and omits flags, current-language index and record identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 13 data and emit declared count, flags, every exact/indexed language string and current-language reference before applying approved normalization.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Installable Languages scope, Type 13 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse the full Type 13 string set, validate count and current-language membership, interpret identifiers using the format flag and compare exact plus normalized representations across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 13 BIOS Language Information implementations.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS and parser/dmidecode versions plus approved locale-policy revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 13 count, flags, installable-language strings and current-language semantics, approved BIOS language policy and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Expands a truncated grep to complete indexed list parsing with format/current-language integrity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage for missing/trailing/duplicate languages, wrong format interpretation and invalid current-language references without adding UI claims.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected format-aware language inventory and normalization/order policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Metadata only advertises language availability; it does not prove every BIOS page is correctly translated or selectable.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a reduced language set or identifier alias, but must bind it to the exact BIOS release and format flag; completion does not imply UI localization quality passed.
expected_evidence: Approved BIOS release, language set/order, identifier format and normalization policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 13 raw/decoded record with count, flags, indexed exact strings and current-language index/value
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot record diff
Engineer verdict; optional UI evidence separately identified

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets the Type 13 installable-language list and persistence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The complete list is safely parseable; missing expected languages or UI scope is execution readiness.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects list truncation and adds format/count/current-language integrity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains language-policy and no-UI-claim safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates optional manual UI localization evidence and engineer verdict from metadata capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a correct first language from hiding missing later entries and prevents comparing identifiers under the wrong format convention.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 13 exposes a finite indexed language string set plus count, flag and current reference; all stated metadata checks are deterministic software operations.
